description: Configure shift requirements, duty roles, leaderboards, and quotas.

content.name: enableShifts
content.description: This unlocks the ability for staff to use a shifts system, where they can get on-duty, off-duty, take a break and see their total duty time.

content.name: onDutyRole
content.description: Role given to users when they are on-duty. This is optional, but recommended to easily identify who is on-duty.

content.name: dutyTypes
content.description: The types of duty a staff member can select when going on-duty.

content.name: minShiftDuration
content.description: A minimum shift duration for a shift to count towards their duty time. Default is 0, which means all shift time counts.

content.name: enableLeaderboard
content.description: If enabled, staff can see a leaderboard of who has the most duty time in the configured timeframe.

content.name: leaderboardLookback
content.description: The timeframe of the duty time shown on the leaderboard.

content.name: enableQuotas
content.description: If enabled, you can set a custom quota of hours for staff to meet in the configured timeframe.

content.name: quotaTimeframe
content.description: The timeframe in which the quota must be met.

content.name: quotas
content.description: Set required hours per role - the left side will be the role, and the right side is a number which is the hours for the quota. The user's highest role counts as their quota.

content.name: logShiftChanges
content.description: When enabled, shift changes (such as going on-duty, on break, or off-duty) will be logged in a custom channel.

content.name: logShiftChangesChannel
content.description: The channel where shift changes will be logged. You can set this empty to use the general log channel.
